title.ur: Mukaalma 1: Aap kya kaam karte hain?

intro.en: Two friends, Majid and Basam, talk about their jobs: where they work, how many hours a day, and whether they love their work.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do dost, Majid aur Basam, apne kaam ke baare mein baat karte hain: kahan kaam karte hain, din mein kitne ghante, aur kya unhein apna kaam pasand hai.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ صَديقانِ، ماجِدٌ وَبَسّامٌ، عَنْ عَمَلِهِما: أَيْنَ يَعْمَلان، وَكَمْ ساعَةً في اليَوْم، وَهَلْ يُحِبّانِ عَمَلَهُما.

dialogue.ar: يا بَسّام، ماذا تَعْمَلُ في هذِهِ الأَيّام؟
dialogue.tr: yā Bassām, mādhā taʿmalu fī hādhihi l-ayyām?
dialogue.en: Bassam, what do you do these days?
dialogue.ur: Bassam, tum aajkal kya kaam karte ho?

dialogue.ar: أَنا مُهَنْدِس. وَأَنْتَ يا ماجِد، ما عَمَلُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: anā muhandis. wa anta yā Mājid, mā ʿamaluk?
dialogue.en: I am an engineer. And you, Majid, what is your job?
dialogue.ur: Main engineer hoon. Aur tum Majid, tumhara kya kaam hai?

dialogue.ar: أَنا طَبيبٌ، وَأَعْمَلُ في مُسْتَشْفى المَدينَة.
dialogue.tr: anā ṭabībun, wa aʿmalu fī mustashfā l-madīna
dialogue.en: I am a doctor, and I work in the city hospital.
dialogue.ur: Main doctor hoon aur shehar ke hospital mein kaam karta hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أَعْمَلُ في شَرِكَةٍ كَبيرَةٍ لِبِناءِ البُيوت.
dialogue.tr: wa anā aʿmalu fī sharikatin kabīratin li-bināʾi l-buyūt
dialogue.en: And I work in a big company that builds houses.
dialogue.ur: Aur main ek badi company mein kaam karta hoon jo ghar banati hai.

dialogue.ar: ما عَدَدُ ساعاتِ عَمَلِكَ كُلَّ يَوْم؟
dialogue.tr: mā ʿadadu sāʿāti ʿamalika kulla yawm?
dialogue.en: How many hours is your work each day?
dialogue.ur: Tumhare kaam ke ghante roz kitne hote hain?

dialogue.ar: أَعْمَلُ سِتَّ ساعاتٍ، وَأَنْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: aʿmalu sitta sāʿātin, wa anta?
dialogue.en: I work six hours. And you?
dialogue.ur: Main chhe ghante kaam karta hoon, aur tum?

dialogue.ar: عَمَلي طَويل، تِسْعُ ساعاتٍ كُلَّ يَوْم.
dialogue.tr: ʿamalī ṭawīl, tisʿu sāʿātin kulla yawm
dialogue.en: My work is long, nine hours every day.
dialogue.ur: Mera kaam lamba hai, roz nau ghante.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ تُحِبُّ هذا العَمَلَ الطَّويلَ يا ماجِد؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal tuḥibbu hādhā l-ʿamala ṭ-ṭawīla yā Mājid?
dialogue.en: And do you love this long work, Majid?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya tumhein yeh lamba kaam pasand hai Majid?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُساعِدَ المَرْضى.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, uḥibbu an usāʿida l-marḍā
dialogue.en: Yes, I love to help the sick.
dialogue.ur: Haan, mujhe beemaron ki madad karna pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَبْنِيَ البُيوتَ لِلنّاس.
dialogue.tr: wa anā uḥibbu an abniya l-buyūta li-n-nās
dialogue.en: And I love to build houses for people.
dialogue.ur: Aur mujhe logon ke liye ghar banana pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: ما أَجْمَلَ العَمَلَ الذي نُحِبُّه!
dialogue.tr: mā ajmala l-ʿamala lladhī nuḥibbuh!
dialogue.en: How beautiful is the work we love!
dialogue.ur: Kitna khoobsurat hai woh kaam jo hum pasand karte hain!

q.en: How many hours a day does Basam work?
q.ur: Basam din mein kitne ghante kaam karta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً يَعْمَلُ بَسّامٌ في اليَوْم؟

q.en: How do you say "Do you love your work?"
q.ur: "Kya aap apne kaam se mohabbat karte hain?" Arabic mein kaise kahenge?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنْ حُبِّ العَمَل؟

intro.en: A teacher asks her pupils what they will be when they grow up, in shā' Allāh. Notice سَأَعْمَلُ – "I will work".
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ustaani apne shagirdon se poochti hain ke bade ho kar woh kya banenge, in shā' Allāh. Dhyan dein: سَأَعْمَلُ ka matlab hai "main kaam karunga".
intro.ar: تَسْأَلُ المُعَلِّمَةُ تَلامِيذَها ماذا سَيَعْمَلونَ عِنْدَما يَكْبَرون إِنْ شاءَ الله. نَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِمَةَ «سَأَعْمَلُ» لِلْمُسْتَقْبَل.

dialogue.ar: يا أَوْلادي، ماذا سَتَعْمَلونَ عِنْدَما تَكْبَرون، إِنْ شاءَ الله؟
dialogue.tr: yā awlādī, mādhā sa-taʿmalūna ʿindamā takbarūn, in shāʾa llāh?
dialogue.en: My children, what will you do when you grow up, if Allah wills?
dialogue.ur: Mere bachon, bade ho kar aap kya karenge, in shaa Allah?

dialogue.ar: أُحِبُّ المَرْضى، لِذلِكَ سَأَدْرُسُ التَّمْريضَ وَسَأَعْمَلُ مُمَرِّضاً.
dialogue.tr: uḥibbu l-marḍā, lidhālika sa-adrusu t-tamrīḍa wa sa-aʿmalu mumarriḍan
dialogue.en: I love the sick, so I will study nursing and work as a nurse.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe beemar pasand hain, isliye main tamreez parhunga aur nurse banunga.

dialogue.ar: أَنا أُحِبُّ الدَّواء، سَأَدْرُسُ الصَّيْدَلَةَ وَسَأَعْمَلُ صَيْدَلِيّاً.
dialogue.tr: anā uḥibbu d-dawāʾ, sa-adrusu ṣ-ṣaydalata wa sa-aʿmalu ṣaydaliyyan
dialogue.en: I love medicine, I will study pharmacy and work as a pharmacist.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe dawai pasand hai, main saidlah parhunga aur pharmacist banunga.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا أَنا فَأُحِبُّ السَّماء، وَسَأَدْخُلُ كُلِّيَّةَ الطَّيَرانِ لِأَعْمَلَ طَيّاراً.
dialogue.tr: ammā anā fa-uḥibbu s-samāʾ, wa sa-adkhulu kulliyyata ṭ-ṭayarāni li-aʿmala ṭayyāran
dialogue.en: As for me, I love the sky, and I will enter the College of Aviation to work as a pilot.
dialogue.ur: Rahi main, mujhe aasmaan pasand hai, aur main Tayaran college mein dakhil ho kar pilot banunga.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أُحِبُّ بِناءَ البُيوت، سَأَدْرُسُ الهَنْدَسَةَ وَسَأَعْمَلُ مُهَنْدِساً.
dialogue.tr: wa anā uḥibbu bināʾa l-buyūt, sa-adrusu l-handasata wa sa-aʿmalu muhandisan
dialogue.en: And I love building houses, I will study engineering and work as an engineer.
dialogue.ur: Aur mujhe ghar banana pasand hai, main handasah parhunga aur engineer banunga.

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ الله! وَأَنْتَ يا بِلال، ماذا سَتَعْمَلُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh! wa anta yā Bilāl, mādhā sa-taʿmal?
dialogue.en: Masha Allah! And you, Bilal, what will you do?
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Aur tum Bilal, tum kya karoge?

dialogue.ar: سَأَعْمَلُ مُدَرِّساً مِثْلَكِ يا مُعَلِّمَتي، إِنْ شاءَ الله.
dialogue.tr: sa-aʿmalu mudarrisan mithlaki yā muʿallimatī, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: I will work as a teacher like you, my teacher, if Allah wills.
dialogue.ur: Main aap ki tarah ustaad banunga, meri ustaani, in shaa Allah.

dialogue.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ فيكُمْ جَميعاً، وَوَفَّقَكُمُ الله.
dialogue.tr: bāraka llāhu fīkum jamīʿan, wa waffaqakumu llāh
dialogue.en: May Allah bless you all and grant you success.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap sab ko barkat de aur kaamyabi ata farmaye.

q.en: Who will work as a nurse?

q.ur: Kaun sa college udaan (flying) ke liye hai?

q.en: What do we add at the end to say "if Allah wills"?
q.ur: "Agar Allah ne chaha" kehne ke liye aakhir mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا نَقولُ لِنَعْنِيَ أَنَّ الأَمْرَ بِمَشيئَةِ الله؟

intro.en: Layla and Noura are teachers. They talk about their job, school stage and children.
intro.ur: Layla aur Noura dono ustaaniyan hain. Woh apne pesha, school ki jamaat (stage) aur bachon ke baare mein baat karti hain.
intro.ar: لَيْلى وَنورَةُ مُدَرِّسَتان. تَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ مِهْنَتِهِما وَالمَرْحَلَةِ الدِّراسِيَّةِ وَالأَطْفال.

dialogue.ar: صَباحُ الخَيْرِ يا نورَة، ما مِهْنَتُكِ؟
dialogue.tr: ṣabāḥu l-khayri yā Nūra, mā mihnatuki?
dialogue.en: Good morning, Noura, what is your profession?
dialogue.ur: Subah bakhair Noura, aap ka kya pesha hai?

dialogue.ar: أَنا مُدَرِّسَةٌ في مَدْرَسَةِ الحَيّ.
dialogue.tr: anā mudarrisatun fī madrasati l-ḥayy
dialogue.en: I am a teacher in the neighbourhood school.
dialogue.ur: Main mohalle ke school mein ustaani hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا مُدَرِّسَةٌ أَيْضاً! ما المَرْحَلَةُ التي تُدَرِّسينَ فيها؟
dialogue.tr: wa anā mudarrisatun ayḍan! mā l-marḥalatu llatī tudarrisīna fīhā?
dialogue.en: I am a teacher too! Which stage do you teach in?
dialogue.ur: Main bhi ustaani hoon! Aap kis jamaat (stage) ko parhati hain?

dialogue.ar: تَلامِيذي كِبارٌ قَليلاً، هُمْ في المَرْحَلَةِ المُتَوَسِّطَة، أُدَرِّسُهُمُ العَرَبِيَّة. وَأَنْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: talāmīdhī kibārun qalīlan, hum fī l-marḥalati l-mutawassiṭa, udarrisuhumu l-ʿarabiyya. wa anti?
dialogue.en: My pupils are a little older, they are in the intermediate stage, I teach them Arabic. And you?
dialogue.ur: Mere shagird zara bade hain, woh mutawassit jamaat mein hain, main unhein Arabi parhati hoon. Aur aap?

dialogue.ar: أُدَرِّسُ أَطْفالَ المَرْحَلَةِ الابْتِدائِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: udarrisu aṭfāla l-marḥalati l-ibtidāʾiyya
dialogue.en: I teach the children of the primary stage.
dialogue.ur: Main ibtidai jamaat ke bachon ko parhati hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ لَدَيْكِ أَطْفالٌ في البَيْت؟
dialogue.tr: wa hal ladayki aṭfālun fī l-bayt?
dialogue.en: And do you have children at home?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya aap ke ghar mein bachay hain?

dialogue.ar: نَعَم، عِنْدي طِفْلانِ فَقَط. وَأَنْتِ؟
dialogue.tr: naʿam, ʿindī ṭiflāni faqaṭ. wa anti?
dialogue.en: Yes, I have only two children. And you?
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, mere sirf do bachay hain. Aur aap ke?

dialogue.ar: عِنْدي ثَلاثَةُ أَطْفال: وَلَدانِ وَبِنْت.
dialogue.tr: ʿindī thalāthatu aṭfāl: waladāni wa bint
dialogue.en: I have three children: two boys and a girl.
dialogue.ur: Mere teen bachay hain: do beton aur ek beti.

dialogue.ar: ما شاءَ الله! هَلْ تُحِبّينَ هذِهِ المِهْنَةَ يا نورَة؟
dialogue.tr: mā shāʾa llāh! hal tuḥibbīna hādhihi l-mihnata yā Nūra?
dialogue.en: Masha Allah! Do you love this profession, Noura?
dialogue.ur: Masha Allah! Kya aap ko yeh pesha pasand hai Noura?

dialogue.ar: كَثيراً، أُحِبُّ الأَطْفالَ وَأُحِبُّ عَمَلي.
dialogue.tr: kathīran, uḥibbu l-aṭfāla wa uḥibbu ʿamalī
dialogue.en: Very much, I love children and I love my work.
dialogue.ur: Bahut, mujhe bachay pasand hain aur apna kaam bhi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا كَذلِكَ يا نورَة، الحَمْدُ لله.
dialogue.tr: wa anā ka-dhālika yā Nūra, al-ḥamdu li-llāh
dialogue.en: Me too, Noura, praise be to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Main bhi, Noura, alhamdulillah.

q.en: How many children does Noura have?

options_ar: العَمَلُ الذي يَكْسِبُ مِنْهُ الإِنْسانُ رِزْقَه

q.ur: Noura kaun si jamaat (stage) parhati hai?

intro.en: Match people to their colleges, and learn the hours of the clock: الواحِدَة (one o'clock) up to الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَة (twelve).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum logon ko unke colleges se milate hain aur ghadi ke ghantay seekhte hain: الواحِدَة (ek baje) se الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَة (barah baje) tak.
intro.ar: نَرْبِطُ الأَشْخاصَ بِكُلِّيّاتِهِم، وَنَتَعَلَّمُ ساعاتِ الوَقْتِ مِنَ الواحِدَةِ إِلى الثّانِيَةَ عَشْرَة.

q.ur: Kaun sa lafz "ghadi / ghanta" ko kehte hain?
Kaun sa college ustaad taiyar karta hai?

title.ur: Jumlon ke andaaz: ghantay aur bachay

intro.en: Practise questions and answers: how many hours do you work, how many children do you have, and ordering words into sentences.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein sawal jawab ki mashq hai: aap kitne ghante kaam karte hain, aap ke kitne bachay hain, aur lafzon ko tarteeb dena.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ على الأَسْئِلَةِ وَالأَجْوِبَة: كَمْ ساعَةً تَعْمَل؟ كَمْ طِفْلاً لَك؟ وَنُرَتِّبُ الكَلِماتِ لِنُكَوِّنَ جُمَلاً.

q.en: How do you ask "How many hours do you work a day?"
q.ur: "Aap din mein kitne ghante kaam karte hain?" kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَنْ عَدَدِ ساعاتِ العَمَلِ في اليَوْم.
اِخْتَرِ الجَوابَ لِمَنْ لَهُ خَمْسَةُ أَطْفال.

q.en: Put in order: "I study engineering at the College of Engineering"
q.ur: Tarteeb dein: "Main engineering college mein engineering parhta hoon"
q.ar: رَتِّبِ الكَلِماتِ لِتُكَوِّنَ جُمْلَةً صَحيحَةً عَنْ دِراسَةِ الهَنْدَسَة.

intro.en: Listen and repeat words with the heavy letter ض (ḍād), like رَمَضان, مُمَرِّض and أَيْضاً. Then hear it in verses of the Qur'an.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein harf ض (zaad) wale lafz sunein aur dohraein, jaise رَمَضان، مُمَرِّض aur أَيْضاً. Phir Quran ki aayaat mein isay sunein.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ وَنُكَرِّرُ كَلِماتٍ فيها حَرْفُ الضّادِ المُفَخَّم، مِثْلَ رَمَضان وَمُمَرِّض وَأَيْضاً، ثُمَّ نَسْمَعُهُ في آياتٍ مِنَ القُرْآن.

q.en: Which letter is taught in this lesson?
q.ur: Is sabaq mein kaun sa harf sikhaya gaya hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ نَتَعَلَّمُهُ في هذا الدَّرْس؟

options_ar: امْرَأَةٌ تَفْحَصُ المَرْضى وَتَكْتُبُ لَهُمُ الدَّواء

intro.en: Practise talking with a partner: ask about working hours, where someone studies, and what they will do after studying.
intro.ur: Apne saathi ke saath baat karne ki mashq: kaam ke ghantay, kahan parhte hain, aur parhai ke baad kya karenge.
intro.ar: نَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زَميلٍ فَنَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ ساعاتِ العَمَلِ وَمَكانِ الدِّراسَةِ وَماذا سَيَعْمَلُ بَعْدَ الدِّراسَة.

vocab.en: How many hours do you work?
vocab.ur: Aap kitne ghante kaam karte hain?

q.en: Answer: "I study at the College of Medicine."
q.ur: Jawab: "Main medical college mein parhta hoon."

q.en: Ask: "What will you do after studying?"
q.ur: Poochein: "Parhai ke baad aap kya karenge?"
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ السُّؤالَ عَمّا سَيَعْمَلُهُ المَرْءُ بَعْدَ الدِّراسَة.

q.en: Answer: "I will work as a doctor, if Allah wills."
q.ur: Jawab: "Main doctor banunga, in shā' Allāh."
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ الجَوابَ لِمَنْ يُريدُ أَنْ يَكونَ طَبيباً إِنْ شاءَ الله.

intro.en: Read a short passage about Omar, a pilot, and answer questions about his work, hours and days off.
intro.ur: Umar pilot ke baare mein ek chhota paragraph parhein aur uske kaam, ghanton aur chhutti ke baare mein sawalon ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ فِقْرَةً قَصيرَةً عَنْ عُمَر، وَهُوَ طَيّار، وَنُجيبُ عَنْ عَمَلِهِ وَساعاتِهِ وَأَيّامِ إِجازَتِه.

q.en: How many hours a day does Omar work?
q.ur: Umar din mein kitne ghante kaam karta hai?
q.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً يَعْمَلُ عُمَرُ في اليَوْم؟

q.en: How many days a week does he work?
q.ur: Woh hafte mein kitne din kaam karta hai?

q.en: On which days is his holiday?
q.ur: Uski chhutti kin dinon mein hoti hai?

q.en: How does Omar go to the company?

intro.en: Join letters to make words, put scrambled letters in order, and write short sentences about jobs and colleges.
intro.ur: Haroof ko jod kar lafz banayein, bikhre hue haroof ki tarteeb theek karein, aur pesha aur colleges ke baare mein chhote jumle likhein.
intro.ar: نَصِلُ الحُروفَ لِنُكَوِّنَ كَلِمات، وَنُرَتِّبُ الحُروفَ المُبَعْثَرَة، وَنَكْتُبُ جُمَلاً قَصيرَةً عَنِ المِهَنِ وَالكُلِّيّات.

q.en: Join the letters ط + ف + ل to make a word.
q.ur: ط + ف + ل ko jod kar lafz banayein.
q.ar: صِلِ الحُروفَ ط + ف + ل لِتَكْتُبَ كَلِمَة.

q.en: Which word is a place of work?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz kaam ki jagah hai?

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يُجَهِّزُ الدَّواء؟

options_ar: ما نَأْكُلُهُ في الصَّباحِ وَالظُّهْرِ وَاللَّيْل

intro.en: A review of jobs, colleges, hours, children and the letter ض from this unit and the last.
intro.ur: Is unit aur pichhle unit ke pesha, colleges, ghantay, bachon aur harf ض ka dohrao.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْمِهَنِ وَالكُلِّيّاتِ وَالسّاعاتِ وَالأَطْفالِ وَحَرْفِ الضّادِ مِنْ هذِهِ الوَحْدَةِ وَالَّتي قَبْلَها.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَعْمَلُ في الهَنْدَسَة؟

q.ur: Kaun sa college pharmacy sikhata hai?
"Mujhe apna kaam pasand hai" kaise kahenge?
q.ar: اِخْتَرِ الجُمْلَةَ التي يَقولُ بِها المَرْءُ إِنَّهُ يُحِبُّ عَمَلَه.

options_ar: رَجُلٌ يَفْحَصُ المَرْضى وَيَكْتُبُ لَهُمُ الدَّواء
